record.what_it_does: Help Scout is a shared-inbox helpdesk platform (email, live chat, knowledge base) that exposes a REST API for managing conversations, customers, mailboxes, knowledge-base docs, and workflow automation.
record.auth_notes: The primary Inbox API 2.0 (and Chat API) use OAuth2 with Authorization Code flow (for third-party/multi-user integrations) or Client Credentials flow (server-to-server). The separate Docs API uses a static API key sent via HTTP Basic Auth (key as username, dummy password).
record.access_notes: Help Scout's Free plan (5 users, 1 inbox, 1 Docs site) does not include API access per the pricing page's feature table. API access (with rate limits of 200/400/800 calls per minute) is listed only under the paid Standard/Plus/Pro tiers. A developer can get working OAuth credentials via the 15-day free trial of Standard or Plus (no credit card required), but ongoing/production use requires a paid subscription.
record.main_blocker: API access gated behind a paid plan (Standard/Plus/Pro); Free plan excludes API access, only reachable via 15-day trial
